value.rationale: The independent two-founder/occasionally receptive ecological founding model captures a meaningful dose-diversification tension already empirically motivated in the 2018 study. The theorem supplies the exact unique continuous ideal dose, complete integer-budget staircase, exhaustive tie conditions, the first transition equation, and a large-budget density law. These are structural all-budget allocation benchmarks, not a routine substitution or a field-calibrated recommendation.
